name: File Exchange Multiplayer
author: PyGameMaker
description: 1990s-DOS-style turn-based multiplayer over a shared folder (a mapped network drive, a synced Dropbox/OneDrive folder, a school SMB share) -- for turn-based classroom games (quizzes, Tic-Tac-Toe, negotiation games) on a LAN whose firewall blocks the direct connections extensions/multiplayer_lan/ needs. Host-authoritative rounds: host_game_files / join_game_files / set_shared_var_files / end_turn, plus the file-session lifecycle events. Desktop only. See docs/MULTIPLAYER_FILE_EXCHANGE_PLAN.md.
